page.content:
Fellowship in which no knight sits above another.

How Round Table connects

  • Location: Camelot — The Round Table sits in Arthur's hall at Camelot.
  • Character: King Arthur — Arthur is the head of the Round Table fellowship.
  • Character: Lancelot — Lancelot is the Table's greatest knight.
  • Item: Siege Perilous — The Siege Perilous is the reserved seat of the Round Table.
  • Character: Gawain — Gawain is Arthur's nephew among the Table.
  • Character: Galahad — Galahad takes the Siege Perilous at the Table.
  • Character: Perceval — Perceval rides from the Table toward the Grail.
  • Character: Kay — Kay serves as seneschal of the Table.
  • Character: Bedivere — Bedivere is among the last knights of the Table.
  • Character: Mordred — Mordred sits at the Table before he breaks the realm.

What is Round Table?

The Round Table, said to have come from Leodegrance with Guinevere, is the institution of Arthur's court: equal seats, the Siege Perilous, and a brotherhood that the Grail and the queen's love undo.

Key threads lead to Camelot, King Arthur, Lancelot, Siege Perilous, Gawain and Galahad.
